divergences.description: Story 3.2's acceptance criterion says recording starts as soon as the user switches into the Áudio tab. In the diff, entering Áudio shows an idle mic button with "Toque para gravar", and recording only starts when the user taps it. The tab-switch listener no longer calls startRecording(). The code comments call this a prototype 'correction', but nothing in spec 3.2 records it: its Spec Change Log is empty and the AC is unchanged.

Several UI changes labelled as prototype 'corrections' are not mentioned in any plan: the close 'x' moved to the left of the tabs, a pill-shaped tab track, 72pt round record/stop buttons, a 12-bar waveform, Câmera/Galeria shown as icon cards instead of buttons, two thumbnail sizes with the small one beside the text, duration captions on the processing and transcribed audio states, and a red timer. Each one comes with new design tokens.

Keyboard and safe-area behaviour was added that no plan mentions: useSafeArea: true on the sheet, tapping anywhere on the sheet dismisses the keyboard, the field is unfocused before every programmatic pop, and SystemChannels.textInput 'TextInput.hide' is called after the sheet closes.

Story 3.4 planned exactly three cross-tab tests and said to reuse the existing fakes as-is. The diff adds two more tests (Áudio→Foto during transcription, Foto→Áudio during OCR). It also gives the existing fakes new configurable behaviour: a transcribeGate on _FakeAudioTranscriber, and a nextResult on _FakeMediaRepository, which previously always threw. The plan's deviation log only covers the amplitude-stream test.

The implementation instead shows an idle mic button ('Toque para gravar') and only starts recording on an explicit tap; the tab-switch listener only cancels on leaving. Spec 3.4's 'Foto→Áudio ... recording starts immediately' criterion is likewise implemented as 'ready to record'.

divergences.description: Spec 3.2 says recording starts and stops from InsertionModal's tab-switch listener, and its acceptance criterion says recording starts immediately when the user switches into Áudio. In the diff, entering Áudio does not start recording. It shows an idle mic button ('Toque para gravar'), and recording starts only when the user taps it. The tab-switch listener only cancels when leaving the tab. Spec 3.4's 'Foto→Áudio ... starts recording immediately' acceptance criterion is also weakened: the test now taps the mic button. Code comments call this a 'Correction' to match the prototype, but no spec text, Review Finding or Change Log entry records it.

The Story 3.3 commit also includes Audio-tab hardening that 3.3's Never clause forbids: try/catch around hasPermission/start/stop, the _stopping guard, _safeCancelRecorder, the RecordMicRecorder negative-duration clamp with an injectable clock, and the waveform onError handler. These change the Áudio tab's behavior beyond the shared InsertionModal wiring.

Spec 3.3 says mimeType is inferred from the extension for jpeg/png/webp only, matching the contract enum. The implementation silently labels any other extension (for example HEIC) as image/jpeg instead of rejecting it, so mislabeled bytes get sent to media-ocr. The plan says nothing about how unsupported extensions should be handled.
